guildInfo.about: Kaizen is a chill but serious Horde raiding guild pushing into 25-man progression content on TBC Classic. We're building a solid, consistent roster of players who show up prepared, respect each other's time, and want to actually clear content — without the toxicity. If that sounds like you, come hang.
guildInfo.recruitment:
We are actively building our 25-man roster and looking for reliable, raid-ready players.

Current loot system:
2 Soft Reserves · MS > OS + 1

All specs considered — reach out on Discord if you're interested in running with us.
guildInfo.lootRules:
2 Soft Reserves (SR) — each raider may reserve up to 2 items per raid week.
MS > OS — main spec rolls beat off spec rolls on all items.
+1 Rule — once you win a main spec item, you go to the back of the line for subsequent drops that night.

tools.name: That's My BIS
tools.desc: Raiders pre-list their BIS items by priority. When loot drops, loot council can instantly see who has it highest on their list, making decisions fast and transparent. Sign up at thatsmybis.com with your Discord account.

tools.name: Gargul
tools.desc: In-game addon used by the loot master to manage rolls, track MS/OS, and distribute loot cleanly. Integrates directly with TMB. Install via CurseForge — only the loot master strictly needs it, but raiders benefit from having it too.

tools.name: Method Raid Tools
tools.desc: Essential raid leader addon. Tracks raid cooldowns, manages assignments, handles notes and reminders, and inspects raiders gear and specs. Required for officers, strongly recommended for all raiders. Install via CurseForge.

assigns.notes: Warlocks + Hunters kill sporebats, everyone focus DPS, grounding totem needs to be down at all times by Shaman in tank group. Static charge, isolate.

rows.valueB: At phase transition to clean up adds

rows.valueA: Hunters kill sporebats, isolate if you have static charge, stay out of poison, paladins blessing of freedom on tanks, shamans grounding totem down!

Coilfang Hate-Screamer - Kill first in all packs, has silence

Underbog Colossus - Acid Geyser: Run to tank
Spore Quake: Run away from mob
Coilfang Priestess - Kill first, has an AOE heal/damage

Greyheart Tidecaller - Kill first, kill totems that spawn water elementals.

Greyheart Nether-Mage - Keep sheeped while killing them. Does AOE damage.

Greyheart Shield-Bearer - STACK on these guys, they will charge. Can be catastrophic if there are multiple.
Coilfang Fathom-Witch - Kill first, will MC. Best to CC your MC'd friends.

Astromancer - Kill first, does AOE blast wave. Purge Molten Armor.

Star Scryer - Keep/spam sheep, can MC and does AOE arcane damage.

Bloodwarder Legionnaire - Tank separate from group. Does Whirlwind.

Bloodwarder Marshal - Patrol pat, comes with squires. Does Whirlwind.

Bloodwarder Vindicator - Uncleansable Flash of Light heal, Hammer of Justice stun, and Cleanse (dispels our CC on nearby mobs) - keep sheeped targets away from Vindicators so Cleanse can't break the polymorph. (Difficulty/pacing notes from the source guide are pre-nerf and may not hold on this server's current tuning - verify live, this line is just the ability kit.)

Crystalcore Sentinel - AOE Arcane damage. Does Overcharge. When this ability happens OT can taunt.

Crystalcore Devastator - Countercharge does reflect damage on auto attacks.

Crystalcore Mechanic - Banish. Saw blade does massive AOE +Bleed damage.

Tempest Smith - Keep/spam sheep. Does AOE bomb damage that reduces armor.
Nether Scryer - Kill first. MASS mind control. Must be tanked out of main room. CC your MC'd friends.

Crimson Hand Battle Mage - Kill first. Has 3 Mass AOE skills.

Crimson Hand Centurion - Keep/spam sheep. Arcane Flurry will kill everyone.

Spread 6 yards - Needle Spine hits anyone within 6yds of target.

Buddy system: pair everyone up so each has a partner responsible for pulling their Impaling Spine.

Don't pop Tidal Shield with the spine until EVERYONE is above 8,500 HP - he only regens 1% HP/sec, so there's no rush.

8 minute enrage - you won't hit it. Play clean.

Each phase lasts 60 seconds, alternating.

PHASE 1: OT stays in melee range, 2nd/3rd on threat, kept topped off - Hateful Strike should always land on the OT, not a DPS. At ~5s left in phase (55s mark), everyone (melee included) spreads for the P2 transition.

PHASE 2: Stay within 5-40 yards of the boss. Fixate targets are RANDOM - if he targets you, run (you can use the ramp to kite, just don't range your healers off it). Dodge Molten Flame and Volcanic Geysers. Threat drops when he returns to P1, so stop DPS right before the transition back.

rows.valueB: Phase 2 (60s DPS check on the Shade)

rows.valueA:
PHASE 1: Kill the 6 Channelers surrounding the Shade first - consider keeping a trash add alive in the middle as a Seed of Corruption target. One tank per doorway to pick up spawning adds: a Sorcerer/Elementalist/Rogue spawns every ~35s, a Defender every ~60s. Casters/healers stay 5yds from Defenders to avoid Shield Bash interrupts. Sorcerers can't be tanked, just kill them.

PHASE 2: Tanks hold adds, healers keep tanks alive. You have 60 seconds to kill the Shade of Akama or he kills Akama.

Tank and spank - Shadow of Death marks a target who dies after 55s and becomes a Vengeful Spirit (4 Shadowy Constructs spawn with them). Make sure your pet bar is active before pull (non-pet classes: Steam Tonk Controller). As a Spirit, construct-kill rotation is 5, 4, 3, 3, 3, 3 - tab targets between the 3's. Once your constructs are down, use ability 1 on the boss, and help other Spirits kill theirs.

Doom Blossoms are a soft enrage - boss should be dead before they matter.

Lasts 60s before Phase 2 (then recurs after 30s of P2). Melee form two groups on the boss's feet.

Blood Boil hits the 5 furthest players - split the rest of the raid into 3 groups of 5 (exclude healers/melee if possible) and rotate every 10 seconds: two groups stack together, the third crosses to soak, then rotates back.

All DPS stay below all tanks on threat - rotate MDs as needed. Bewildering Strike forces a tank swap; the active tank should also slow threat if Acidic Wound stacks get to 7-10.

Starts after 60s of P1, lasts 30s. Fel Rage targets a RANDOM player (+15k armor/30k HP/100% healing/300% dmg/100% size on them) - spam heals on them, use defensives (shields, evasion), do NOT feign or ice block. Paladins should run a BoP rotation for the Fel Rage target.

Spread for Fel Geyser (18yd knockback around the Fel Rage target), but be ready to collapse back to P1 positions.

THIS IS NOT A THREAT WIPE - Insignificance only snapshots threat at P1's end; when P2 ends he returns to whoever tanked him at the END of P1. Pop Bloodlust/Heroism once stable and nuke.

No threat table - boss attacks whoever's closest, so the tank rotation needs to move in/out as they get low (DPS players can fill in too). Run a BoP rotation; Rogues can Evasion-tank the Enrage (every 45s, 15s duration).

NO healing is possible this phase (Aura of Suffering) - all other healers should DPS the boss, though Power Word: Shield still works, so keep a priest on shield duty for whoever's tanking.

Don't be afraid to use all your mana - the Intermission between phases fully refills HP and mana. Dispel Soul Drain immediately.

Aura of Desire reflects 50% of your damage done back to you (and doubles healing done) - play clean, don't overnuke yourself.

Mage spellsteals Rune Shield immediately (50k absorb + interrupt immunity + attack speed). Warrior tank MUST Spell Reflect Deaden (100% increased damage taken debuff). Spirit Shock must be interrupted every cast - run a rotation with backups (Rogues with PvP gloves can solo it, but have backups ready regardless).

After 160s everyone hits 0 mana - this phase is about clean execution and communication, don't rush it.

rows.valueB: Right after MT taunt + threat buff

rows.valueA:
OT initiates the pull; MT taunts immediately after and builds threat off the 200% threat buff (Seethe). Hunters can MD the MT and start attacking right away; rest of DPS waits a few seconds before joining. Pop cooldowns + Bloodlust once MT has aggro.

Spite targets 3 random players (7500 dmg after a 2s immunity window) - healers focus heals on whoever's hit.

Warrior MT: watch the Soul Scream timer and stance-dance right before it casts to drop rage and minimize the damage taken from the frontal cone.

Shadow resistance is close to mandatory - aim for 174+ unbuffed on everyone. Tanks don't need SR, gear for HP/mitigation/avoidance instead (can't be crushed, so a bear tank is fine) - all 3 stack together in front of the boss, keep Ironshields up.

FATAL ATTRACTION: as soon as you're teleported and linked with 2 others, immediately run away from each other to break the link.

BEAMS (Sinful/Vile/Sinister/Wicked): just heal through them, stack tightly to make it simpler on healers.
OT (Veras - repicks up after each vanish)
Interrupt (Malande - Circle of Healing) - ranged backup
Priest - shield Veras' poison targets ASAP

GATHIOS (DPS focus target): MT moves him out of his own Consecration - melee don't wait for the tank, move the moment you see it. Spell Reflect Seal of Command's Judgement if possible. Dispel Hand of Judgement (random stun) ASAP.

ZEREVOR: must be tanked by a Mage, who spellsteals Dampen Magic and needs a dedicated healer. Casts Arcane Explosion if anyone's in melee range - stay out. Interrupt Arcane Bolt as much as possible (ranged rotation). Move immediately out of Blizzard/Flame Strike.

MALANDE: needs melee + ranged interrupters on Circle of Healing (mandatory interrupt) - if she's immune to physical, ranged has to cover it alone. Can be kited next to Gathios/Veras for cleave damage on faster kills.

VERAS: vanishes and reappears on a random target with Deadly Poison + Envenom - OT must repick him up quickly, priests shield the poison target ASAP. Once picked up, bring him near Gathios to get cleaved.

Ranged and healers stack. MT uses Shield Block/Holy Shield to block Shear (reduces max HP by 60% for 7s, cannot miss). Move Illidan slightly after each Flame Crash.

Melee: stay out from in front of Illidan so Draw Soul (heals him 100k) doesn't land on anyone extra.

Parasitic Shadowfiend target runs away from the raid - kill the 2 adds immediately when they spawn (consider slow traps).

2 Fire Resist tanks kite the Flames of Azzinoth along the planned paths - never let a Flame breathe on the raid, and keep the Flame within 25yds of its glaive (Uncaged Wrath enrage = wipe if not).

Dodge Eye Blast's blue fire trail as it lands (stays 1 min, 2k/sec if stood in) - tanks CAN walk through it after it's landed if needed, just call it out.

Ranged + healers split into 3 marked groups between the elementals to spread Fireball damage - communicate if a group needs to move for an Eye Blast trail. Focus one Flame down fully before swapping to the other. Melee: don't stand in fire for extra DPS.

Repeat Phase 1's strat exactly, except everyone now spreads 5 yards for Agonizing Flames (5yd AoE + heavy DoT on whoever it hits).

Designate a spot (or spots) ahead of time for Parasitic Shadowfiends to be dropped, slowed, and killed.

Entire raid spreads out. A Warlock with Shadow Resistance gear tanks Illidan this phase, standing ~20yds away from everyone else - Shadow Blast hits highest threat + anyone within 20yds.

Flame Burst hits the whole raid (spread 5yds to soften it). Kill Summoned Shadow Demons immediately - they fixate, stun, and kill on contact.

Many guilds push to skip most of this phase - Illidan transitions to Phase 5 at 30%, so if your DPS supports it, lust in Phase 3 to get him there fast.

Repeat Phase 3's strat. Watch Illidan's Enrage (40s in - +30% attack speed/+50% damage) - healers and MT need to be ready, save cooldowns/potions for this stretch.

Maiev drops traps on the platform during this phase - consider numbering/naming regions ahead of time so the raid can call out trap locations fast. MT kites Illidan into a trap to strip the enrage and increase damage taken.

If you reach Phase 5, you can kill the boss. Glaives are MT loot priority.

Stack in a circle around him. Use stun-breaks (or PvP trinkets) to get out of Icebolt fast. Melee can use Living Action Potion when boss has frost armor with healers focused on whoever gets stunned. Move out of Death and Decay - a big red circle that can be easy to miss, so watch your feet.

Use NPCs to help with the fight.

Spread in a circle, keeping healers apart so Carrion Swarm doesn't hit more than one at a time. The Infernal target moves away from the raid before it lands, then MDs it to the OT - most groups burn the Infernal down fast rather than leave it up.

First MD: Zuul > Hasu
Second MD: Ako > Hasu
Third MD: Mike > Hasu

Spread out - mana users watch their mana and move away from others as it drops, since hitting 0 mana causes an AoE explosion. Ret/Prot Paladins are most at risk (low mana pools); Warlocks can stack freely since Mana Tap keeps them safe. MT faces him away from melee; OTs can help soak Cleave.

Spread out. Whoever gets the Doom debuff runs to the designated NPC group (Tauren/Thrall) so they help kill the Doomguard that spawns on death - OT picks it up and holds it, DPS ignores it and stays on the boss. Move out of fire.

One tank only (can't be crushed - Druid works well). Every group needs a shaman in Tremor Totem range for the fear. Avoid the moving fire patches (fear can push you into one), decurse Grip of the Legion immediately, and keep everyone alive - a death triggers a nasty Soul Charge effect. He has less HP than Gruul; this fight is about clean positioning, not a DPS race.

trashBestiary.name: Shadowy Necromancer

abilities.title: Shadow Bolt (ID: 31627)
abilities.desc: 2435-2975 Shadow damage. Interruptable.

abilities.title: Unholy Frenzy (ID: 31626)
abilities.desc: Increases target's attack speed by 100% for 20 sec. Inflicts 250 Nature damage per second. Lasts 20 seconds. Dispellable. Works on MC.

abilities.title: Cripple (ID: 33787)
abilities.desc: Increases time between attacks by 100%; slows by 50%; reduces strength by 15%. 15 second duration. Interruptable; Dispellable.

abilities.title: Raise Dead (ID: 31617, 31624, 31625)
abilities.desc: Summons 1 of 3 combinations of skeleton allies.

trashBestiary.tip: Kill first. Stagger the casts to avoid your tank being hit too hard. Stuns and interrupts all work. Grounding totem is very helpful here!

trashBestiary.name: Abomination

abilities.title: Disease Cloud (ID: 31607)
abilities.desc: Deals 694 Nature damage every 3 seconds to enemies within 3 yds.

abilities.title: Knockdown (ID: 31610)
abilities.desc: Stuns primary target for 2 seconds; 4000 physical damage.

trashBestiary.tip: Have off-tanks pick 1-2 up and everything should be fine. Tanks should use Ironshield Potions for extra armor OR use Free Action Potions to avoid the stun.

trashBestiary.name: Banshee

abilities.title: Banshee Curse (ID: 17905)
abilities.desc: Reduces melee & ranged hit chance by 66% for 5 minutes. Can be decursed.

abilities.title: Anti-Magic Shell (ID: 31662)
abilities.desc: Absorbs 200,000 magic damage. Lasts 30 seconds.

abilities.title: Banshee Wail (ID: 38183)
abilities.desc: 2475-3025 Shadow damage to an enemy. Interruptable.

trashBestiary.tip: Keep decurses going. Interrupt if possible, but it's not a huge deal. Always save interrupts for Necromancers. Melee kill through AMS after Necromancers are dead.

trashBestiary.name: Gargoyle

abilities.title: Gargoyle Strike (ID: 31664)
abilities.desc: 850-1150 Nature damage to an enemy.

trashBestiary.tip: Get aggro and pull to the ground. LoS helps a lot - check the wave notes below for specific strategies on certain waves.

trashBestiary.name: Frost Wyrm

abilities.title: Frost Breath (ID: 31688)
abilities.desc: Slows and deals 2550-3450 Frost damage to target & any enemies within 8 yds of target. Slow can be dispelled.

trashBestiary.tip: Get aggro and pull to the ground. Ranged focus; melee can hit when they get close to the ground.

trashBestiary.name: Infernal

abilities.title: Flame Buffet (ID: 31724)
abilities.desc: Increases fire damage taken by 50 for 1 min. Stacks infinitely. Can be dispelled.

abilities.title: Immolation (ID: 39007)
abilities.desc: Deals 414-456 Fire damage to enemies within 15 yds every 2 seconds.

trashBestiary.tip: Can be stunned and banished. Not as scary as they look; let tanks get aggro, then blow them up.

trashBestiary.name: Fel Stalker

abilities.title: Mana Burn (ID: 31729)
abilities.desc: Hits an enemy with an anti-mana bolt. Each point of mana drained deals 0.5 points of damage. Interruptable.

trashBestiary.tip: Recommend that you banish these and kill them last. Mana Burn is annoying, but things die quickly enough that it's not a massive detriment. Organize interrupts and stuns if needed.

trashBestiary.name: Coilskar General

abilities.title: Free Friend
abilities.desc: Removes crowd control from a nearby ally. Makes CC unreliable while this mob is alive.

abilities.title: Booming Voice
abilities.desc: Buffs nearby allies with increased melee haste and faster casting.

trashBestiary.tip: The #1 kill priority in any sewer pull it shows up in - left alive, it unravels your CC and buffs everything else.

trashBestiary.name: Aqueous Spawn

abilities.title: Sludge Nova
abilities.desc: Targeted Nature AoE damage plus a poison DoT that also slows movement by 20%.

trashBestiary.tip: Low HP, high AoE output - kill or interrupt it fast rather than letting the nova land.

trashBestiary.name: Coilskar Sea-Caller

abilities.title: Forked Lightning
abilities.desc: Frontal chain-lightning attack. Immune to taunt.

trashBestiary.tip: Can't be tanked normally since it's taunt-immune - just turn it (and the raid) away from the attack.

trashBestiary.name: Dragon Turtle

abilities.title: Shell Shield
abilities.desc: Reflects roughly half of magic damage back at the caster while active.

trashBestiary.tip: Stop casting direct damage into it while shielded and swap to another target until the shield drops.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Fearbringer

abilities.title: War Stomp
abilities.desc: AoE stun that can't be outranged.

trashBestiary.tip: Pop a Free Action Potion and burst it down on pull; watch for its patrol overlapping with nearby packs.

trashBestiary.name: Bonechewer Taskmaster

abilities.title: Enrage (aura)
abilities.desc: Buffs nearby Bonechewer Workers with an enrage if left alive too long.

trashBestiary.tip: Kill first, before the Workers around it start snowballing.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Centurion

abilities.title: Frontal Cleave
abilities.desc: Melee cleave hitting everyone in front of it.

abilities.title: Sonic Strike
abilities.desc: A long-duration frontal silence.

trashBestiary.tip: Focus these down first in any mixed Illidari pack and keep them faced away from the raid.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Heartseeker

abilities.title: Rapid Shot
abilities.desc: Rapid ranged attacks that ordinary stuns do not reliably stop.

trashBestiary.tip: Needs a hard incapacitate (Gouge, Repentance, an engineering grenade) rather than a stun to shut down.

trashBestiary.name: Ashtongue Mystic

abilities.title: Chain Heal
abilities.desc: Standard chain heal - keep it on the interrupt rotation.

abilities.title: Bloodlust
abilities.desc: Casts Bloodlust on nearby allies - offensively dispel it.

abilities.title: Windfury Totem
abilities.desc: Buffs nearby allies with extra attacks.

trashBestiary.tip: Interrupt Chain Heal, dispel Bloodlust off its allies, and destroy any totem it drops the moment you see it.

trashBestiary.name: Ashtongue Feral Spirit

abilities.title: Aggro Radius (passive)
abilities.desc: Unusually large detection range compared to other trash.

trashBestiary.tip: You can't sneak past it by hugging a wall - have a mage pop Invisibility and walk the raid past instead.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Nightlord

abilities.title: Pulsing Hellfire
abilities.desc: Periodic AoE fire damage around the caster.

abilities.title: AoE Fear
abilities.desc: Fears nearby players, which can chain-pull the next pack if unchecked.

trashBestiary.tip: Tremor totems are mandatory on this pull - a feared player running into the next group is how wipes start.

trashBestiary.name: Shadowmoon Reaver

abilities.title: Spell Absorption
abilities.desc: Stacks a magic damage shield on itself over time.

abilities.title: Detonate
abilities.desc: Explodes for 60,000+ damage to nearby players if still alive roughly 15 seconds after engaging.

trashBestiary.tip: Always the first kill target in any pack it shares - do not let the timer run out.

trashBestiary.name: Shadowmoon Champion

abilities.title: Frontal Cone
abilities.desc: Melee cone attack in front of the mob.

abilities.title: Ground Weapons
abilities.desc: Drops weapons on the ground that Whirlwind on their own.

trashBestiary.tip: Face it away from the raid and keep repositioning off the ground weapon hazards.

trashBestiary.name: Bonechewer Blood Prophet

abilities.title: Bloodbolt
abilities.desc: Shadow bolt-style damage spell.

abilities.title: Blood Drain
abilities.desc: Drains health from a target to heal itself.

trashBestiary.tip: Ordinary stuns and interrupts do not reliably stop its casts - use a hard incapacitate instead.

trashBestiary.name: Bonechewer Blade Fury

abilities.title: Whirlwind
abilities.desc: Melee attack hitting all nearby enemies.

trashBestiary.tip: Priority kill right after the Blood Prophet is controlled - chain-stun it down before it can Whirlwind.

trashBestiary.name: Bonechewer Shield Disciple

abilities.title: Shield Wall
abilities.desc: Activates a heavy damage-reduction shield once it drops to roughly 50% health.

trashBestiary.tip: Silence it (Death Coil or similar) before it reaches 50%, or the pull stalls out on a shielded mob.

trashBestiary.name: Bonechewer Behemoth

abilities.title: Meteor / Comet
abilities.desc: Heavy single-target or ground-targeted damage.

trashBestiary.tip: Fight it alone where possible; stack up on the hit to split the damage across more players.

trashBestiary.name: Priestess of Torment / Priestess of Delight

abilities.title: Shared Health Pool
abilities.desc: The linked pair fights off one combined health total.

abilities.title: Reflective Shield (Torment)
abilities.desc: Torment's shield reflects a portion of damage back at attackers.

trashBestiary.tip: Never split the pair apart. Kill Delight first (either order works, but this is the common approach).

trashBestiary.name: Mistress of Dementia

abilities.title: Disorient
abilities.desc: Disorients nearby players.

abilities.title: Mirror Image (on death)
abilities.desc: Spawns a temporary image of itself when it dies.

trashBestiary.tip: Call her health % before she dies and pull melee off her immediately so no one eats the death image's hit.

trashBestiary.name: Mistress of Woe

abilities.title: Curse of Vitality
abilities.desc: A dispellable shadow damage-over-time curse.

trashBestiary.tip: Keep it decursed on cooldown - never let it sit on someone at unsafe health.

trashBestiary.name: Promenade Sentinel

abilities.title: Arcane Charge
abilities.desc: Ramps from raid-wide chip damage at low stacks up to a hit equal to the target’s entire max HP at high stacks.

trashBestiary.tip: Pull each one solo at full raid health with a Power Word: Shield ready for whoever gets tagged.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Archon

abilities.title: Smite
abilities.desc: Standard holy damage bolt.

abilities.title: Power Word: Shield
abilities.desc: Shields itself or an ally, absorbing incoming damage.

trashBestiary.tip: Nothing too dangerous on its own - just don't ignore the shield it puts up.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Battle-mage

abilities.title: Blizzard
abilities.desc: Ground-targeted AoE frost damage over time.

trashBestiary.tip: Needs a hard incapacitate on the cast, not just an interrupt - assign a dedicated control player.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Blood Lord

abilities.title: Divine Shield
abilities.desc: Becomes briefly immune to damage.

trashBestiary.tip: Save a Mass Dispel for the shield, or the kill stalls out completely.

trashBestiary.name: Illidari Assassin

abilities.title: Vanish / Ambush
abilities.desc: Vanishes and reappears with a burst opener, often on a healer.

abilities.title: Paralyzing Poison
abilities.desc: Applies a stun on hit.

trashBestiary.tip: Watch for the reappear-plus-stun combo landing on your healers.

waves.notes: Tanks pop FAP for Abom stun; OTs pull 1-2 off of MT.

waves.mobs: 6 Ghoul | 4 Crypt Fiend | 2 Abomination | 2 Shadowy Necromancer

waves.notes: OTs help with Aboms.

waves.mobs: 3 Ghoul | 3 Crypt Fiend | 2 Shadowy Necromancer | 4 Abomination | 2 Banshee

waves.notes: Pull to tall tauren tent.
Gargoyles in back (check by Thrall).
Big stuns/interrupts.
LoS into Orc Bunker.
Kill ghouls & aboms quickly. Be ready to burn Wyrm.

waves.mobs: 6 Ghoul | 2 Crypt Fiend | 2 Shadowy Necromancer | 4 Abomination | 2 Banshee

waves.notes: DPS wait in bunker. Pally get aggro & run back. OTs hit necros.
LoS in hut; run out & spread when Wyrm spawns.
Meet in middle.
Banish stalkers if needed.
Stagger necromancers' casts.
Stagger necromancers' casts.

waves.mobs: 2 Ghoul | 2 Crypt Fiend | 8 Giant Infernal | 2 Fel Stalker
4 Crypt Fiend | 2 Shadowy Necromancer | 4 Abomination | 4 Banshee | 2 Fel Stalker

waves.notes: Solo pack, low HP. Kick or arcane-bomb their Sludge Nova volley before it goes off.
Patrol. Turn everything away from the raid; interrupt any Aqueous Spawn it summons immediately.
Wranglers are taunt-immune (Lightning Prod / Electric Spur) - pull them aside or just cleave everything together.

waves.mobs: 2 Coilskar Sea-Caller | 2 Aqueous Surger | 2 Coilskar General
waves.notes: Hardest pull in the sewers (sometimes swapped for 2 General | 2 Dragon Turtle | 2 Harpooner). Coilskar Generals are the #1 kill priority - they strip CC and buff nearby allies with Booming Voice. Dragon Turtles reflect magic via Shell Shield, so stop casting into one until the shield drops.
Kill the Taskmaster immediately - it enrages the Workers if left alive.
Patrol. Skippable by hugging the right side near the spikes.
War Stomp can't be outranged. Pop a Free Action Potion and burst it down; watch for its patrol overlapping with the Sky Stalkers.
Can't be solo-pulled - it cleaves the 3 closest targets. Have a ranged player pull it alone and Iceblock/Bubble out if it follows.

waves.mobs: 2 Illidari Centurion | 2 Illidari Defiler | 1 Illidari Bone Slicer | 1 Illidari Heartseeker
waves.notes: Two packs. Focus Centurions first (frontal cleave + a long silence). Pull the right-hand pack first and LOS around the corner so you don't chain-pull the patrol.
Patrol with 2 escorts. Pulsing Hellfire + an AoE Fear. Tremor totems are mandatory or the fear chain-pulls the next group.
Absurd aggro radius - you can't just hug the wall past it. Have a mage pop Invisibility and walk the raid in.

waves.mobs: 1 Ashtongue Feral Spirit | 1 Ashtongue Mystic | 1 Ashtongue Primalist | 1 Ashtongue Stormcaller | 1 Ashtongue Battlelord
waves.notes: Two packs. Kill Mystics first and destroy any totems the moment they drop - Windfury Totem and Cyclone Totem both need to die on sight.
Always the first kill in any pack it shares - it stacks Spell Absorption on itself, then explodes for 60k+ damage if still alive after ~15 seconds.

waves.mobs: 1 Shadowmoon Champion | Blood Mage | Weapon Master | Deathshaper
waves.notes: Champions drop ground weapons that Whirlwind on their own - keep repositioning off them. Face everything away from the raid.
Right side of the room, not skippable. Pull and LOS down the stairs to group it up.
Channeling a skeleton - fully skippable by walking through the middle of the room.
Optional pack - the Soldiers are harmless. Pull together or just wait out the patrol first.
Prioritize any Reavers; the Grunt dies almost instantly.
Blood Mages hit a big frontal cone (Blood Siphon). Mind Soothe them to skip the pack entirely, or pull and LOS into Gorefiend’s room.
Two pairs. Can't be taunted - just damage through them.

waves.mobs: 1 Bonechewer Behemoth | Bonechewer Blade Fury | Bonechewer Blood Prophet | Bonechewer Shield Disciple | 2 Mutant War Hound
waves.notes: Roughly 6 mixed Bonechewers plus 2 War Hounds. Kill Blade Furies first, avoid standing in a War Hound's death poison cloud, and Death Coil (or another silence) a Shield Disciple before it hits 50% and shields up.

waves.mobs: Bonechewer Brawler | Bonechewer Combatant | 1 Bonechewer Behemoth
waves.notes: Stationary pack plus a patrolling Behemoth. Clear the stationary pack first, then the Behemoth, then the second pack - don't let the patrol merge into a live pull.
Patrol with 2 escorts on the backtrack route from Bloodboil - same as the Akama-wing Nightlord, tremor totems required.

waves.mobs: 1 Bonechewer Behemoth | Bonechewer Blade Fury | Bonechewer Blood Prophet | Bonechewer Shield Disciple | Bonechewer Brawler | Bonechewer Combatant | 1 Mutant War Hound
waves.notes: Halls of Anguish. Blood Prophet needs a hard incapacitate - stuns/interrupts alone won't reliably stop its casts. Once it's controlled, chain-stun and kill Blade Fury next.

Gauntlet run to the boss ramp - red ghosts are most dangerous, blue/purple are larger but less threatening, Soul Fragments can mostly be ignored. Everything respawns on a ~15 second timer, so keep the whole raid moving together - a fast runner or a lagging healer stretches the pack into a wipe. Stop and AoE at 1/3, 2/3, and again on top of the ramp; kill red ghosts first, then mop up trailing Soul Fragments while still moving.
With escorts. Tremor totems mandatory, same as earlier.

waves.mobs: 2 Illidari Centurion | 2 Illidari Defiler | 1 Illidari Heartseeker | 1 Illidari Bone Slicer
waves.notes: Handle the same as the Akama-wing version of this pack.
~30k HP each. Nothing special - just nuke them down.

waves.mobs: 1 Priestess of Torment | 1 Priestess of Delight
waves.notes: Patrol pair - shares one health pool, do not split them apart. Kill Delight first (works either order, but this is the common approach).

waves.mobs: 1 Mistress of Dementia | 1 Mistress of Woe
waves.notes: Keep Curse of Vitality decursed off whoever it lands on. Call Dementia's health % before she dies and pull melee off her immediately - she spawns a mirror image on death.

Three solo patrols. Arcane Charge ramps from raid-wide chip damage (L1) up to a hit for the target’s entire max HP (L5). Go into every pull at full health with a Power Word: Shield ready to drop on whoever gets tagged.

waves.mobs: 1 Illidari Archon | 1 Illidari Assassin | 1 Illidari Battle-mage | 1 Illidari Blood Lord
waves.notes: Two packs. Battle-mage's Blizzard needs a hard incapacitate, not just an interrupt. Save a Mass Dispel for Blood Lord's Divine Shield or the kill stalls out completely.
